verdict: Google profiles are active; overdue milestones are the priority this month.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, your Google Business Profiles generated a combined 397 actions — directions, web clicks, and calls — with zero paid spend active on any channel. O'Hare Precision Metals showed real momentum, with profile engagement up 23% week over week, while Forte Precision Metals and Advance Grinding Services saw GBP engagement fall 52% and 41% respectively in the most recent 7 days, a confirmed softening that is being monitored. The broader constraint is that organic profile activity is carrying the entire lead load with no paid channels running, and a series of CRM, SEO, outreach, and content milestones — the oldest dating to July — remain open and are being prioritized for resolution now. As those milestones close, pipeline visibility and outreach sequences will come online, giving these profiles the infrastructure they need to convert existing traffic into trackable leads.
